integrity: The infinite-family homotopy classification is derived from explicit simplicial collapses and join identifications. Finite sample checks are supplementary and do not establish the infinite theorem.
limitations: Applies to two-rank vertex–facet incidence posets of cross-polytopes, not full face posets or arbitrary finite topological spaces. Exhaustive novelty is not certified; a hidden equivalent hypergraph formulation is a residual risk.
title: Exponential dual flag-sphere gap for cross-polytopal vertex–facet spaces
